spells.description: You send a short message of 25 words or fewer to a creature you have met or a creature described to you by someone who has met it. The target hears the message in its mind, recognizes you as the sender if it knows you, and can answer in a like manner immediately. The spell enables targets to understand the meaning of your message. You can send the message across any distance and even to other planes of existence, but if the target is on a different plane than you, there is a 5 percent chance that the message doesn't arrive. You know if the delivery fails. Upon receiving your message, a creature can block your ability to reach it again with this spell for 8 hours. If you try to send another message during that time, you learn that you are blocked, and the spell fails.

spells.name: Slow
spells.description: You alter time around up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot Cube within range. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected by this spell for the duration. An affected target's Speed is halved, it takes a −2 penalty to AC and Dexterity saving throws, and it can't take Reactions. On its turns, it can take either an action or a Bonus Action, not both, and it can make only one attack if it takes the Attack action. If it casts a spell with a Somatic component, there is a 25 percent chance the spell fails as a result of the target making the spell's gestures too slowly. An affected target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.

spells.name: Speak with Dead
spells.description: You grant the semblance of life to a corpse of your choice within range, allowing it to answer questions you pose. The corpse must have a mouth, and this spell fails if the deceased creature was Undead when it died. The spell also fails if the corpse was the target of this spell within the past 10 days. Until the spell ends, you can ask the corpse up to five questions. The corpse knows only what it knew in life, including the languages it knew. Answers are usually brief, cryptic, or repetitive, and the corpse is under no compulsion to offer a truthful answer if you are antagonistic toward it or it recognizes you as an enemy. This spell doesn't return the creature's soul to its body, only its animating spirit. Thus, the corpse can't learn new information, doesn't comprehend anything that has happened since it died, and can't speculate about future events.

spells.name: Speak with Plants
spells.description: You imbue plants in an immobile 30-foot Emanation with limited sentience and animation, giving them the ability to communicate with you and follow your simple commands. You can question plants about events in the spell's area within the past day, gaining information about creatures that have passed, weather, and other circumstances. You can also turn Difficult Terrain caused by plant growth (such as thickets and undergrowth) into ordinary terrain that lasts for the duration. Or you can turn ordinary terrain where plants are present into Difficult Terrain that lasts for the duration. The spell doesn't enable plants to uproot themselves and move about, but they can move their branches, tendrils, and stalks for you. If a Plant creature is in the area, you can communicate with it as if you shared a common language.

spells.name: Stinking Cloud
spells.description: You create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of yellow, nauseating gas centered on a point within range. The cloud is Heavily Obscured. The cloud lingers in the air for the duration or until a strong wind (such as the one created by Gust of Wind) disperses it. Each creature that starts its turn in the Sphere must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition until the end of the current turn. While Poisoned in this way, the creature can't take an action or a Bonus Action.

spells.name: Tongues
spells.description: This spell grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken or signed language that it hears or sees. Moreover, when the target communicates by speaking or signing, any creature that knows at least one language can understand it if that creature can hear the speech or see the signing.

spells.name: Water Breathing
spells.description: This spell grants up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range the ability to breathe underwater until the spell ends. Affected creatures also retain their normal mode of respiration.

spells.name: Water Walk
spells.description: This spell grants the ability to move across any liquid surface—such as water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, or lava—as if it were harmless solid ground (creatures crossing molten lava can still take damage from the heat). Up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range gain this ability for the duration. An affected target must take a Bonus Action to pass from the liquid's surface into the liquid itself and vice versa, but if the target falls into the liquid, the target passes through the surface into the liquid below.

spells.name: Wind Wall
spells.description: A wall of strong wind rises from the ground at a point you choose within range. You can make the wall up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick. You can shape the wall in any way you choose so long as it makes one continuous path along the ground. The wall lasts for the duration. When the wall appears, each creature in its area makes a Strength saving throw, taking 4d8 Bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The strong wind keeps fog, smoke, and other gases at bay. Small or smaller flying creatures or objects can't pass through the wall. Loose, lightweight materials brought into the wall fly upward. Arrows, bolts, and other ordinary projectiles launched at targets behind the wall are deflected upward and miss automatically. Boulders hurled by Giants or siege engines, and similar projectiles, are unaffected. Creatures in gaseous form can't pass through it.

spells.name: Antilife Shell
spells.description: An aura extends from you in a 10-foot Emanation for the duration. The aura prevents creatures other than Constructs and Undead from passing or reaching through it. An affected creature can cast spells or make attacks with Ranged or Reach weapons through the barrier. If you move so that an affected creature is forced to pass through the barrier, the spell ends.

spells.name: Befuddlement
spells.description: You blast the mind of a creature that you can see within range. The target makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 10d12 Psychic damage and can't cast spells or take the Magic action. At the end of every 30 days, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on a success. The effect can also be ended by the Greater Restoration, Heal, or Wish spell. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

components.material: a key ring with no keys

spells.name: Blink
spells.description: Roll 1d6 at the end of each of your turns for the duration. On a roll of 4–6, you vanish from your current plane of existence and appear in the Ethereal Plane (the spell ends instantly if you are already on that plane). While on the Ethereal Plane, you can perceive the plane you left, which is cast in shades of gray, but you can't see anything there more than 60 feet away. You can affect and be affected only by other creatures on the Ethereal Plane, and creatures on the other plane can't perceive you unless they have a special ability that lets them perceive things on the Ethereal Plane. You return to the other plane at the start of your next turn and when the spell ends if you are on the Ethereal Plane. You return to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of the space you left. If no unoccupied space is available within that range, you appear in the nearest unoccupied space.

spells.name: Divine Smite
spells.description: Component: V The target takes an extra 2d8 Radiant damage from the attack. The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is a Fiend or an Undead. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

spells.name: Elementalism
spells.description: You exert control over the elements, creating one of the following effects within range. Beckon Air. You create a breeze strong enough to ripple cloth, stir dust, rustle leaves, and close open doors and shutters, all in a 5-foot Cube. Doors and shutters being held open by someone or something aren't affected. Beckon Earth. You create a thin shroud of dust or sand that covers surfaces in a 5-foot-square area, or you cause a single word to appear in your handwriting in a patch of dirt or sand. Beckon Fire. You create a thin cloud of harmless embers and colored, scented smoke in a 5-foot Cube. You choose the color and scent, and the embers can light candles, torches, or lamps in that area. The smoke's scent lingers for 1 minute. Beckon Water. You create a spray of cool mist that lightly dampens creatures and objects in a 5-foot Cube. Alternatively, you create 1 cup of clean water either in an open container or on a surface, and the water evaporates in 1 minute. Sculpt Element. You cause dirt, sand, fire, smoke, mist, or water that can fit in a 1-foot Cube to assume a crude shape (such as that of a creature) for 1 hour.

spells.name: Floating Disk
spells.description: This spell creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 feet in diameter and 1 inch thick, that floats 3 feet above the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The disk remains for the duration and can hold up to 500 pounds. If more weight is placed on it, the spell ends, and everything on the disk falls to the ground. The disk is immobile while you are within 20 feet of it. If you move more than 20 feet away from it, the disk follows you so that it remains within 20 feet of you. It can move across uneven terrain, up or down stairs, slopes and the like, but it can't cross an elevation change of 10 feet or more. For example, the disk can't move across a 10-foot-deep pit, nor could it leave such a pit if it was created at the bottom. If you move more than 100 feet from the disk (typically because it can't move around an obstacle to follow you), the spell ends.

spells.name: Freezing Sphere
spells.description: A frigid globe streaks from you to a point of your choice within range, where it explodes in a 60-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature in that area makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d6 Cold damage on failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. If the globe strikes a body of water, it freezes the water to a depth of 6 inches over an area 30 feet square. This ice lasts for 1 minute. Creatures that were swimming on the surface of frozen water are trapped in the ice and have the Restrained condition. A trapped creature can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC to break free. You can refrain from firing the globe after completing the spell's casting. If you do so, a globe about the size of a sling bullet, cool to the touch, appears in your hand. At any time, you or a creature you give the globe to can throw the globe (to a range of 40 feet) or hurl it with a sling (to the sling's normal range). It shatters on impact, with the same effect as a normal casting of the spell. You can also set the globe down without shattering it. After 1 minute, if the globe hasn't already shattered, it explodes. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 6.

spells.name: Ice Knife
spells.description: You create a shard of ice and fling it at one creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Piercing damage. Hit or miss, the shard then explodes. The target and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 Cold damage. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The Cold damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

components.material: a drop of water or a piece of ice

spells.name: Illusory Script
spells.description: You write on parchment, paper, or another suitable material and imbue it with an illusion that lasts for the duration. To you and any creatures you designate when you cast the spell, the writing appears normal, seems to be written in your hand, and conveys whatever meaning you intended when you wrote the text. To all others, the writing appears as if it were written in an unknown or magical script that is unintelligible. Alternatively, the illusion can alter the meaning, handwriting, and language of the text, though the language must be one you know. If the spell is dispelled, the original script and the illusion both disappear. A creature that has Truesight can read the hidden message.

components.material: ink worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes

spells.name: Mind Spike
spells.description: You drive a spike of psionic energy into the mind of one creature you can see within range. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw, taking 3d8 Psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, you also always know the target's location until the spell ends, but only while the two of you are on the same plane of existence. While you have this knowledge, the target can't become hidden from you, and if it has the Invisible condition, it gains no benefit from that condition against you. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 2.

spells.name: Shining Smite
spells.description: Component: V The target hit by the strike takes an extra 2d6 Radiant damage from the attack. Until the spell ends, the target sheds Bright Light in a 5-foot radius, attack rolls against it have Advantage, and it can't benefit from the Invisible condition. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 2.

spells.name: Sorcerous Burst
spells.description: Component: V, S You cast sorcerous energy at one creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 damage of a type you choose: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, Psychic, or Thunder. If you roll an 8 on a d8 for this spell, you can roll another d8, and add it to the damage. When you cast this spell, the maximum number of these d8s you can add to the spell's damage equals your spellcasting ability modifier. Cantrip Upgrade. The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

spells.name: Summon Dragon
spells.description: You call forth a Dragon spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range and uses the Draconic Spirit stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your Initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in the stat block.

components.material: an object with the image of a dragon engraved on it worth 500+ GP

spells.name: Transport via Plants
spells.description: This spell creates a magical link between a Large or larger inanimate plant within range and another plant, at any distance, on the same plane of existence. You must have seen or touched the destination plant at least once before. For the duration, any creature can step into the target plant and exit from the destination plant by using 5 feet of movement.

spells.name: Vitriolic Sphere
spells.description: You point at a location within range, and a glowing, 1-foot-diameter ball of acid streaks there and explodes in a 20-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature in that area makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10d4 Acid damage and another 5d4 Acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half the initial damage only. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The initial damage increases by 2d4 for each spell slot level above 4.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: Heals 2d4+2 hit points when consumed

items.name: Goodberry
items.description: A magical berry created by the Goodberry spell. A creature can take a Bonus Action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 Hit Point.
items.engineNotes: A magical berry created by the Goodberry spell. RAW (SRD 5.2.1): 'A creature can take a Bonus Action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 Hit Point.' Slice 499: a single-use consumable minted (x10) into the caster's inventory by the Goodberry spell's `create-item` mechanic; consumed one at a time via engine.plan.consumeItem (Heal flatAmount 1). The 24-hour expiry of uneaten berries is consumer-managed (the engine doesn't time-expire created items).

items.name: Potion of Greater Healing
items.description: Heals 4d4+4 hit points when consumed

items.name: Potion of Superior Healing
items.description: Heals 8d4+8 hit points when consumed

items.name: Boots of Elvenkind
items.description: While you wear these boots, your steps make no sound, regardless of the surface you are moving across. You also have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
items.engineNotes: RAW (SRD 5.2.1): 'While you wear these boots, your steps make no sound, regardless of the surface you are moving across. You also have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.' Slice 297 wired the Stealth arm via slice-263's skill-discriminated SetAdvantage. The silent-steps arm is pure narrative (no mechanical effect; the engine doesn't model sound).

items.name: Cloak of Elvenkind
items.description: While you wear this cloak with the hood up, Wisdom (Perception) checks made to see you have Disadvantage, and you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.
items.engineNotes: RAW (SRD 5.2.1): 'While you wear this cloak with the hood up, Wisdom (Perception) checks made to see you have Disadvantage, and you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.' Slice 297 wired the bearer-side Stealth advantage arm via slice-263's skill-discriminated SetAdvantage. RAW deviations: (1) the hood-up gate is consumer-managed (engine doesn't model wearer-cloak posture; the consumer who tracks hood state populates a future fact slot or omits the wire); (2) the third-party Perception-disadvantage arm stays deferred — the engine's SetAdvantage is bearer-side, and the per-skill-roll context to swing a check from another creature's perspective (a `bearerImposesDisadvantageOnThirdPartyPerception` shape) hasn't landed. Same deferral applies to Cloak of Displacement's third-party attack-disadvantage. The 'made to hide' qualifier on the Stealth arm is narrative (the engine doesn't distinguish hide-Stealth from other Stealth uses), so the wire fires on all Stealth checks while attuned.

items.name: Slippers of Spider Climbing
items.description: While you wear these slippers, you have a Climb Speed equal to your walking speed.
items.engineNotes: RAW: 'While you wear these slippers, you have a Climb Speed equal to your walking speed.' Slice 290 wired the matchWalkSpeed semantics via the new ModifySpeed `op: 'matchWalkSpeed'` (replaced the pre-slice approximation `op: 'set', value: 30`). The climb speed now scales with the wearer's effective walking speed (Fast Movement / Unarmored Movement etc. fold in).

items.name: Headband of Intellect
items.description: Your Intelligence is 19 while you wear this headband. It has no effect on you if your Intelligence is 19 or higher without it.
items.engineNotes: RAW (SRD 5.2.1): 'Your Intelligence is 19 while you wear this headband. It has no effect on you if your Intelligence is 19 or higher without it.' Slice 298 wired via slice-229 OverrideAbilityScore (floor semantics: applies only when base INT < 19).

items.name: Cloak of the Bat
items.description: You have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while wearing this cloak in an area of dim light or darkness. While wearing this cloak in an area of dim light or darkness, you can use a Magic action to gain a Fly Speed of 40 feet for 1 hour. The cloak can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
items.engineNotes: RAW: 'You have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while wearing this cloak in an area of dim light or darkness. While wearing this cloak in an area of dim light or darkness, you can use a Magic action to gain a Fly Speed of 40 feet for 1 hour. The cloak can't be used this way again until the next dawn.' Slice 279 wired the Stealth arm (SetAdvantage gated on slice-279's `bearer.lightLevel` consumer-supplied fact). conditions.name: Cursed with Lycanthropy
conditions.description: Cursed with lycanthropy. If the creature drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes the were-creature that cursed it, under the GM's control with 10 Hit Points. The curse can be removed by Remove Curse or Greater Restoration.
conditions.engineNotes: Slice 823: marker for the were-creature lycanthropy curse (Werebear/Wereboar/Wererat/Weretiger/Werewolf bite — a CON save gated on Humanoid, applied via the onHit save.conditionOnFail path, sourced by the attacker). Inert in the engine: the '0 HP -> becomes a Were-creature (10 HP)' outcome is a death-replacement + creature-swap that's GM/consumer territory (the engine can't auto-transform; cross-ref the deferred summon/transform primitives). A single marker suffices — which were-form is the attacker's identity (sourceCharacterId).

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.description: bearer's attack rolls have Disadvantage. Melee attacks against the bearer have Advantage; ranged attacks against the bearer have Disadvantage.
conditions.engineNotes: RAW (SRD 5.2.1 Prone): bearer's attack rolls have Disadvantage. Melee attacks against the bearer have Advantage; ranged attacks against the bearer have Disadvantage. The stand-up cost (half speed) is a movement-economy mechanic deferred to a future engine slice. Slice 568 wired the asymmetric attacker-side arms using the new `event.attackKind` fact in the attacker-facts maps.

conditions.name: Innate Sorcery
conditions.description: while active (1 min), the spell save DC of your Sorcerer spells is +1 AND you have Advantage on the attack rolls of your Sorcerer spells.
conditions.engineNotes: RAW 2024 Sorcerer L1: while active (1 min), the spell save DC of your Sorcerer spells is +1 AND you have Advantage on the attack rolls of your Sorcerer spells. Slice 623 added the advantage arm; slice 627 tightened it to fire only when event.spellCastingClassId === 'sorcerer' (cast-spell.ts threads the casting class as a fact). Multiclass sorcerers casting non-Sorcerer-list spells no longer over-benefit. The +1 DC modifier is still unconditional -- it lives on the bearer's spell save DC which is class-aware via the existing computeSpellSaveDC path; tightening it to a Sorcerer-only DC bump is queued behind a separate fact slot (the DC derivation doesn't yet thread a per-event spell-casting class).

conditions.name: Blessed
conditions.description: Bless spell effect.
conditions.engineNotes: Bless spell effect. RAW (SRD 5.2.1): 'the target adds 1d4 to the attack roll or save.' Fully RAW since slice 331: both arms are per-roll AddBonusDie 1d4 (attack arm slice 330; save arm slice 331, which threaded save bonus dice through every save-rolling planner via computeSavingThrow's bonusDice + the shared rollSaveBonusDice helper). The wildcard `save` target (slice 299) applies the die to every ability's save.

conditions.name: Baned
conditions.description: Bane spell effect. subtract 1d4 from each attack roll and saving throw the target makes.' Fully both arms are per-roll AddBonusDie 1d4 with subtract:true.
conditions.engineNotes: Bane spell effect. RAW (SRD 5.2.1): 'subtract 1d4 from each attack roll and saving throw the target makes.' Fully RAW since slice 331: both arms are per-roll AddBonusDie 1d4 with subtract:true (attack arm slice 330; save arm slice 331).

conditions.name: Death Dog Disease
conditions.description: Applied on a failed CON DC 12 save against a Death Dog's Bite. First Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition. While Poisoned, the target's Hit Point maximum doesn't return to normal when finishing a Long Rest, and it repeats the save every 24 hours that elapse, ending the effect on itself on a success. Subsequent Failures: The Poisoned target's Hit Point maximum decreases by 5 (1d10).
conditions.engineNotes: Applied on a failed CON DC 12 save against a Death Dog's Bite. RAW (SRD 5.2.1 Death Dog, CR 1): 'First Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition. While Poisoned, the target's Hit Point maximum doesn't return to normal when finishing a Long Rest, and it repeats the save every 24 hours that elapse, ending the effect on itself on a success. Subsequent Failures: The Poisoned target's Hit Point maximum decreases by 5 (1d10).' Slice 493: carries Poisoned's effects directly (Disadvantage on attacks + ability checks) + recurringSave with fixedDC 12, trigger 'longRest' (slice 493 added this trigger value for 24-hour-cadence saves), onSuccess 'removeCondition'. Consumer calls `engine.plan.tickRecurringSave` on each long-rest tick to roll the save. Deferred RAW arms: (a) 'HP max doesn't return on long rest' — engine doesn't model HP-max-restore semantics, and the long-rest reducer currently doesn't restore max anyway since there's no HP-max-decay mechanism shipping; (b) 'Subsequent Failures: HP max decreases by 1d10' — needs an HP-max-decay accumulator + an onFail variant that emits a max-decay event. Both deferred to a future slice; consumer-managed for now.

conditions.name: Restrained (by web)
conditions.description: Restrained from a web-source effect (Web spell, Giant Spider's Web action when authored, Ettercap webs, etc.). The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs.
conditions.engineNotes: Restrained from a web-source effect (Web spell, Giant Spider's Web action when authored, Ettercap webs, etc.). RAW (SRD 5.2.1 Web Walker trait — Giant Spider, Drider, Ettercap): 'The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs.' Slice 492 introduces this source-tagged variant of Restrained so creatures with Web Walker can carry an immunity to it (via the statblock's `conditionImmunities` array) without being immune to Restrained from other sources (Entangle, grapple, Ensnaring Strike). Effects are a direct copy of the base Restrained condition (ModifySpeed walk 0, Disadvantage on attacks, Disadvantage on DEX saves, GrantAdvantageToAttackers). The Web spell's `conditionOnFail` now points here; future web-source applications (Giant Spider Web action, etc.) use the same id.

conditions.name: Stirge Attached
conditions.description: Applied to a creature when a Stirge's Proboscis hits. and the stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge can't make Proboscis attacks, and the target takes 5 (2d4) Necrotic damage at the start of each of the stirge's turns. The stirge can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the stirge as an action.
conditions.engineNotes: Applied to a creature when a Stirge's Proboscis hits. RAW (SRD 5.2.1 Stirge, CR 1/8): 'and the stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge can't make Proboscis attacks, and the target takes 5 (2d4) Necrotic damage at the start of each of the stirge's turns. The stirge can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the stirge as an action.' Slice 490 wired it: marker condition on the target carrying `sourceCharacterId` = the attaching stirge. The attack resolver gates the stirge's next Proboscis attack on absence of this marker. The consumer calls `engine.plan.stirgeDrain({ stirgeId })` at the stirge's turn-start to deal the 2d4 necrotic; `engine.plan.detachStirge` removes the condition. Deferred (consumer-managed): the 'spend 5 feet of movement to detach' arm — same shape as Disengage / Dash; engine doesn't yet model fractional movement-action costs.

conditions.name: Cockatrice Restrained
conditions.description: Applied on a failed CON DC 11 save against a Cockatrice's Petrifying Bite. First Failure: The target has the Restrained condition. The target repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition, instead of the Restrained condition, for 24 hours.
conditions.engineNotes: Applied on a failed CON DC 11 save against a Cockatrice's Petrifying Bite. RAW (SRD 5.2.1 Cockatrice, CR 1/2): 'First Failure: The target has the Restrained condition. The target repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition, instead of the Restrained condition, for 24 hours.' Slice 488: carries the Restrained effects directly + recurringSave with fixedDC 11 (slice 488), trigger 'turnEnd', onSuccess 'removeCondition' (ends the effect), onFail 'escalateToCondition' with escalateToConditionId 'petrified' (the slice-488 escalation arm). The 24-hour Petrified duration is consumer-managed (the engine doesn't track hours).

conditions.name: Worg Bite Targeted
conditions.description: Applied on a Worg Bite hit. the next attack roll made against the target before the start of the worg's next turn has Advantage.
conditions.engineNotes: Applied on a Worg Bite hit. RAW (SRD 5.2.1 Worg, CR 1/2): 'the next attack roll made against the target before the start of the worg's next turn has Advantage.' Slice 484: GrantAdvantageToAttackers + consumeOnIncomingAttack (the slice-484 attack-resolver target-side mirror of slice-387's consumeOnAttack) so a single attack against the target consumes the buff; autoExpiry afterRounds 1 turnStart bounds the 'before the start of the worg's next turn' envelope when no incoming attack happens.

conditions.name: Shielded
conditions.description: +5 bonus to AC until the start of the caster's next turn (Shield spell).

conditions.name: Aided
conditions.description: +5 to hit point maximum for the duration (Aid spell).

conditions.name: Guided
conditions.description: May add 1d4 to one ability check; consumed on use (Guidance spell).

conditions.name: Dodging
conditions.description: Until the start of your next turn, any attack roll made against you has Disadvantage if you can see the attacker, and you make Dexterity saving throws with Advantage. You lose these benefits if you have the Incapacitated condition or if your Speed is 0.
conditions.engineNotes: RAW (SRD 5.2.1 Dodge action): 'Until the start of your next turn, any attack roll made against you has Disadvantage if you can see the attacker, and you make Dexterity saving throws with Advantage. You lose these benefits if you have the Incapacitated condition or if your Speed is 0.' Slice 272 added the Incap/Speed-0 self-disable on both arms. Slice 278 added the per-attacker LoS gate on the attack-disadvantage arm only (RAW: the LoS clause applies to the attack-disadvantage benefit; the DEX-save advantage has no LoS clause). The attack-disadvantage arm now gates on `all(bearer.hasIncapacitated=false, bearer.speedZero=false, not eq bearer.canSeeAttacker false)`. The consumer (UI, encounter manager, future VTT) supplies `targetCanSeeAttacker` on the AttackIntent when it models line of sight; undefined preserves current behavior (default-apply). The DEX-save advantage arm stays gated only on Incap/Speed-0 per RAW.

conditions.name: Addled
conditions.description: The target can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.' The opportunity-attack planner rejects an OA from an Addled reactor. Modeled like Dodging's 'until the start of your next turn' window via endsOn turnEnd (self); the creature ticks the expiry.
conditions.engineNotes: RAW (Monk Open Hand Technique, Addle option): 'The target can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.' The opportunity-attack planner rejects an OA from an Addled reactor. Modeled like Dodging's 'until the start of your next turn' window via endsOn turnEnd (self); the consumer ticks the expiry. The 'can't make Opportunity Attacks' restriction isn't expressible as an effect primitive (it gates the OA planner, not a roll), so this is an engine-read marker with effects [] (in pack-integrity's EFFECT_LESS_OK allowlist).

conditions.name: Sapped
conditions.description: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.' The bearer attacks with Disadvantage (folded in by the attack resolver's attacker-self advantage).
conditions.engineNotes: RAW (weapon mastery Sap): 'If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.' The bearer attacks with Disadvantage (folded in by the attack resolver's attacker-self advantage). RAW deviation (documented in starter-pack-gaps.md): the engine models 'next attack roll' as Disadvantage on all the bearer's attacks until the start of the attacker's next turn (autoExpiry afterRounds 1, turnStart); with Extra Attack this over-applies vs RAW's single attack. A one-shot-consumption primitive would close the gap.

conditions.name: Slowed (Slow mastery)
conditions.description: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.' Modeled as ModifySpeed walk -10 with autoExpiry afterRounds 1, turnStart (the same shape as power-word-speed-zero-active).
conditions.engineNotes: RAW (weapon mastery Slow): 'If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.' Modeled as ModifySpeed walk -10 with autoExpiry afterRounds 1, turnStart (the same shape as power-word-speed-zero-active). RAW caps the reduction at 10 ft even from multiple Slow sources; stackable is false so re-application doesn't compound.

conditions.name: Helped Against (Help action, Attack mode)
conditions.description: You momentarily distract a foe within 5 feet of you. The next attack roll one of your allies makes against that foe before the start of your next turn has Advantage on the attack roll.
conditions.engineNotes: RAW (PHB 2024 ch.7 Help action, Attack mode): 'You momentarily distract a foe within 5 feet of you. The next attack roll one of your allies makes against that foe before the start of your next turn has Advantage on the attack roll.' Slice 571 wires this as a target-side condition: GrantAdvantageToAttackers + consumeOnIncomingAttack (next attack consumes it) + autoExpiry afterRounds:1 turnEnd (the helper's next turn-end clears the unused condition, matching RAW's 'before the start of your next turn' window).

conditions.name: Helped On Check (Help action, Ability Check mode)
conditions.description: You momentarily help another creature do something. ... The creature has Advantage on that ability check.
conditions.engineNotes: RAW (PHB 2024 ch.7 Help action, Ability Check mode): 'You momentarily help another creature do something. ... The creature has Advantage on that ability check.' Slice 571 wired the SetAdvantage + autoExpiry; slice 577 adds the consumeOnCheck arm so the condition lifts after the bearer's first ability check (RAW: 'that ability check' — singular).

conditions.name: Bardic Inspiration
conditions.description: A creature with the die can roll it and add the number rolled to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes. The creature can wait until after it rolls the d20 before deciding to use the Bardic Inspiration die, but must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails. Once the d20 is rolled, it's lost.
conditions.engineNotes: RAW (PHB 2024 Bard L1 Bardic Inspiration): 'A creature with the die can roll it and add the number rolled to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes. The creature can wait until after it rolls the d20 before deciding to use the Bardic Inspiration die, but must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails. Once the d20 is rolled, it's lost.' Slice 577 wires the die as an AddBonusDie 1d6 (L1 die) applied to all three roll targets (attack / save / check); the bearer's first use of ANY of the three consumes the condition (consumeOnAttack + consumeOnSave + consumeOnCheck). RAW 10-minute duration modeled as autoExpiry afterRounds:100 turnEnd (combat-effective infinity; a future cleanup can move to time-of-day if narrative tracking is desired).

conditions.name: Vexing (Vex mastery)
conditions.description: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to the creature, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.' Applied to the ATTACKER (the vexer) with sourceCharacterId set to the vexed target; SetAdvantageVsSource grants the bearer Advantage on attacks against that source (the mirror of Bestow Curse's cursed-attacks-active).
conditions.engineNotes: RAW (weapon mastery Vex): 'If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to the creature, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.' Applied to the ATTACKER (the vexer) with sourceCharacterId set to the vexed target; SetAdvantageVsSource grants the bearer Advantage on attacks against that source (the mirror of Bestow Curse's cursed-attacks-active). Slice 623: `expirySourceFromBearer: true` makes the autoExpiry sweep key on the BEARER's (the vexer's) turn-end instead of the source's (the vexed target's) -- the slice-622 L1 fuzz review (seed 7000) surfaced this: Vex was expiring at the end of the vexed target's turn, before the vexer could use the advantage on their own next turn. RAW deviation (documented in starter-pack-gaps.md): modeled as Advantage on all the vexer's attacks against that target until the end of the vexer's next turn (autoExpiry afterRounds 1, turnEnd); with Extra Attack this over-applies vs RAW's single attack.

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.description: Disadvantage on bearer's attack rolls; attacks against bearer have Advantage; the bearer can't see and auto-fails sight-dependent checks.
conditions.engineNotes: RAW (SRD 5.2.1 Blinded): Disadvantage on bearer's attack rolls; attacks against bearer have Advantage; the bearer can't see and auto-fails sight-dependent checks. Slice 567 added the GrantAdvantageToAttackers arm (was previously bearer-side-only); the auto-fail sight-check arm remains deferred (no sight-check predicate exists).

conditions.name: Deafened
conditions.description: A deafened creature can't hear and automatically fails any ability check that requires hearing.
conditions.engineNotes: RAW (SRD 5.2.1 Deafened): 'A deafened creature can't hear and automatically fails any ability check that requires hearing.' Slice 580 wires this via a predicate-gated SetAdvantage on { kind: 'check' } with mode 'auto-fail', condition: event.sense == 'hearing'. The check planner threads the consumer-supplied `sense` field into the facts map (slice 263 wiring); when set to 'hearing' and the bearer is Deafened, computeAbilityCheck returns hasAutoFail = true and the planner forces success = false. Default behavior (no sense supplied or sense != 'hearing') is unchanged: the bearer rolls normally.

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.description: Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is within line of sight.
conditions.engineNotes: RAW (SRD 5.2.1 Frightened): 'Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is within line of sight.' Slice 276 fixed two simultaneous bugs in the prior wire: (a) narrow breadth (only STR check disadvantage) replaced with the slice-266 check wildcard so all six abilities are penalized; (b) missing LoS gate added via the new `bearer.canSeeFearSource` consumer-supplied predicate fact. Both arms (attack disadvantage + check wildcard disadvantage) gate on `not eq path:'bearer.canSeeFearSource' value:false` — default-apply semantics: undefined or true fires the disadvantage; only an explicit false bypass (consumer-supplied) suppresses it. Consumers that model line of sight (dndbnb's encounter manager, a VTT) pass the value; consumers without scene state get the strict-RAW default (apply unless explicitly bypassed). The fact is per-bearer (any source of fear in LoS produces true); per-source granularity would need additional engine state and stays deferred.

conditions.name: Grappled
conditions.description: bearer's Speed is 0 (no speed bonuses). The bearer's attack rolls have Disadvantage against any target other than the grappler.
conditions.engineNotes: RAW (SRD 5.2.1 Grappled): bearer's Speed is 0 (no speed bonuses). The bearer's attack rolls have Disadvantage against any target other than the grappler. The Grappled-vs-non-grappler disadvantage gate is the `bearer.targetIsNotGrappler` fact populated by the attack planner (slice 568) — true when the bearer carries a Grappled condition whose sourceCharacterId is not the current target.

conditions.name: Invisible
conditions.description: Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage, and your attack rolls have Advantage. If a creature can somehow see you, you don't gain this benefit against that creature.
conditions.engineNotes: RAW (SRD 5.2.1 Invisible): 'Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage, and your attack rolls have Advantage. If a creature can somehow see you, you don't gain this benefit against that creature.' Slice 273 wired both arms: the bearer's-own-advantage gates on `target.canLocateInvisible=false`, and the new ImposeDisadvantageOnAttackers gates on `attacker.canLocateInvisible=false`. The attack planner populates both facts symmetrically (blindsight / tremorsense / truesight all let the counter-party locate an invisible creature; the Blinded condition does NOT bypass invisibility because a blinded creature can't see anything to begin with). Pre-273 the bearer's advantage applied unconditionally and the disadvantage-on-attackers arm was missing entirely.

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.description: Incapacitated, Speed 0, auto-fails STR + DEX saves, attacks against bearer have Advantage, melee attacks within 5 ft are automatic critical hits.
conditions.engineNotes: RAW (SRD 5.2.1 Paralyzed): Incapacitated, Speed 0, auto-fails STR + DEX saves, attacks against bearer have Advantage, melee attacks within 5 ft are automatic critical hits. Incapacitated is enforced via `assertActorCanAct` (engine code, not effect-list). Slice 567 added the GrantAdvantageToAttackers arm. The within-5-ft auto-crit arm is deferred to slice 568 (needs attack-resolution range check).

conditions.name: Petrified
conditions.description: Incapacitated, Speed 0, attacks against bearer have Advantage, auto-fails STR + DEX saves, Resistance to all damage, immune to Poisoned.
conditions.engineNotes: RAW (SRD 5.2.1 Petrified): Incapacitated, Speed 0, attacks against bearer have Advantage, auto-fails STR + DEX saves, Resistance to all damage, immune to Poisoned. Weight ×10 and disease immunity are narrative arms (no encumbrance / disease primitive). Incapacitated is enforced via `assertActorCanAct`. Slice 567 added the GrantAdvantageToAttackers arm and the auto-fail STR/DEX saves (Petrified composes Paralyzed in RAW).

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.description: Incapacitated, Speed 0, auto-fails STR + DEX saves, attacks against bearer have Advantage.
conditions.engineNotes: RAW (SRD 5.2.1 Stunned): Incapacitated, Speed 0, auto-fails STR + DEX saves, attacks against bearer have Advantage. Incapacitated is enforced via `assertActorCanAct`. Slice 567 added the missing ModifySpeed (Speed 0) and GrantAdvantageToAttackers arms (was previously save-only).

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.description: Incapacitated, Prone (in effect — falls prone unless held aloft), Speed 0, drops what it holds, unaware of surroundings, auto-fails STR + DEX saves, attacks against bearer have Advantage, melee attacks within 5 ft are automatic critical hits.
conditions.engineNotes: RAW (SRD 5.2.1 Unconscious): Incapacitated, Prone (in effect — falls prone unless held aloft), Speed 0, drops what it holds, unaware of surroundings, auto-fails STR + DEX saves, attacks against bearer have Advantage, melee attacks within 5 ft are automatic critical hits. Incapacitated is enforced via `assertActorCanAct`. Slice 567 added GrantAdvantageToAttackers. The within-5-ft auto-crit arm is deferred to slice 568 (needs attack-resolution range check); Prone composition stays implicit (HP-drop reducer separately marks the character).

conditions.name: Expeditious Retreat Active
conditions.description: While concentrating on Expeditious Retreat, you may take the Dash action as a Bonus Action on each of your turns (via planExpeditiousRetreatDash).

conditions.name: Divine Favor Active
conditions.description: +1d4 radiant damage on every weapon hit while concentrating on Divine Favor.

conditions.name: Searing Smite Active
conditions.description: Caster's next weapon hit deals +1d6 fire damage; the spell ends after that hit.

conditions.name: Divine Smite Active
conditions.description: Caster's next melee weapon (or Unarmed Strike) hit deals +2d8 radiant; +1d8 more if the target is a Fiend or Undead. The spell ends after that hit.
conditions.engineNotes: Caster's next melee weapon (or Unarmed Strike) hit deals +2d8 radiant; +1d8 more if the target is a Fiend or Undead. The spell ends after that hit. Slice 444: base form only (no upcast scaling); the +1d8/slot above L1 upcast arm stays deferred pending slot-level-aware buff variants.

conditions.name: Blink
conditions.engineNotes: Slice 672: marker that the Blink spell is active on the bearer. The consumer invokes `engine.plan.blinkTurnEnd({ characterId })` at the end of each of the bearer's turns; on 11+ the bearer gains `blink-ethereal-active`. Duration is consumer-managed (1 minute = 10 rounds; consumer commits ConditionRemoved when expired).

conditions.name: Blink (Ethereal Plane)
conditions.engineNotes: Slice 672: marker that the bearer is on the Ethereal Plane via Blink. Per RAW: while ethereal, the bearer can see + hear original plane (~60-ft), can pass through objects, attacks against/from the bearer auto-miss, and abilities/conditions don't carry across planes. Position changes (10-ft re-emergence) are consumer-managed (engine has no positions). Consumer commits ConditionRemoved at the START of the bearer's next turn.

conditions.name: Beacon of Hope
conditions.engineNotes: Slice 671: composite-buff condition from Beacon of Hope. Projects advantage on WIS saves + `GrantMaxHealingDice` (each healing spell affecting the bearer regains max possible). Slice 679: now also projects `GrantDeathSaveAdvantage` so `planDeathSaveAtTurnStart` rolls 2d20 and takes the higher per RAW. Auto-cleared on the caster's concentration drop.

conditions.name: Slowed (Slow spell)
conditions.engineNotes: Slice 670: composite condition from the Slow spell. Engine projects: walking speed halved (ModifySpeed walk *0.5), AC -2, DEX saves -2. Slice 677: end-of-turn WIS save vs the caster's spell save DC ends the condition (recurringSave); consumer drives via `engine.plan.tickRecurringSave({ targetId, conditionId: 'slowed-by-spell-active' })`. Auto-cleared on the caster's concentration drop. Other RAW arms (no reactions / one-action-or-bonus / max-one-attack / spellcasting 50% V/S/M) are wired in slices 680-682.

conditions.name: Dragon's Breath (Acid)
conditions.engineNotes: Slice 669: marker — the buffed creature can take its action to exhale a 15-ft cone of acid; targets DEX-save vs the caster's spell save DC for 3d6 acid (+1d6/slot above L2), half on success. Consumer invokes `engine.plan.exhaleDragonsBreath({ damageType: 'acid', ... })` on the buffed creature's action. Auto-cleared on the caster's concentration drop.

conditions.name: Dragon's Breath (Cold)
conditions.engineNotes: Slice 669: cold variant of Dragon's Breath. See dragons-breath-acid-active.

conditions.name: Dragon's Breath (Fire)
conditions.engineNotes: Slice 669: fire variant of Dragon's Breath. See dragons-breath-acid-active.

conditions.name: Dragon's Breath (Lightning)
conditions.engineNotes: Slice 669: lightning variant of Dragon's Breath. See dragons-breath-acid-active.

conditions.name: Dragon's Breath (Poison)
conditions.engineNotes: Slice 669: poison variant of Dragon's Breath. See dragons-breath-acid-active.

conditions.name: Levitating
conditions.engineNotes: Slice 668: marker for the Levitate spell. RAW per SRD 5.2.1: the target floats up to 20 ft up vertically; can move 20 ft up or down on its turn as a move action by pulling/pushing against fixed objects (effective fly speed for vertical-only movement). Horizontal movement requires a fixed surface — engine has no positions so consumers manage the horizontal-block. The 20-ft vertical fly is projected as `ModifySpeed { mode: 'fly', op: 'set', value: 20 }` so derived speeds reflect 'fly 20 ft' for consumers reading the effective speed stack. Auto-cleared on the caster's concentration drop.

conditions.name: Phantasmal Force
conditions.engineNotes: Slice 667: marker for Phantasmal Force's per-turn psychic damage tick. Per RAW, while the creature is convinced of the phantasm, on each of its turns it takes 1d6 psychic damage if the phantasm could damage it (the consumer drives this via planTickRecurring at the start of the target's turn). The disbelieve-on-INT-investigation arm is consumer-driven. Auto-cleared on the caster's concentration drop.

conditions.name: Enfeebled (Ray of Enfeeblement)

Carries the base Blinded effects directly (Disadvantage on the bearer's attack rolls; attackers have Advantage), the same shape cockatrice-restrained-active uses for Restrained; the auto-fail sight-dependent-check arm is the same deferred gap as base `blinded` (no sight-check predicate exists). conditions.name: Gaseous Form (active)

The target has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage; it has Immunity to the Prone condition; and it has Advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws. The target can pass through narrow openings, but it treats liquids as though they were solid surfaces.
conditions.engineNotes: Concentration, up to 1 hour (Gaseous Form spell). RAW: 'A willing creature you touch shape-shifts, along with everything it's wearing and carrying, into a misty cloud for the duration. While in this form, the target's only method of movement is a Fly Speed of 10 feet, and it can hover. The target can enter and occupy the space of another creature. The target has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage; it has Immunity to the Prone condition; and it has Advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws. The target can pass through narrow openings, but it treats liquids as though they were solid surfaces.' Slice 287 wired the mechanical arms via existing primitives: OverrideACFormula sets AC to a flat 11 (RAW: the cloud has AC 11), GrantResistance covers B/P/S, GrantConditionImmunity on prone, SetAdvantage on STR/DEX/CON saves. RAW deviations carried forward: the Fly Speed 10 ft is declarative-only (slice 263's pattern-check finding: 0 consumers read non-walk ModifySpeed entries — needs slice-227-row's non-walk speed derive to surface mechanically); 'can't speak, manipulate objects, attack, or cast spells' is consumer-managed (the engine doesn't auto-restrict the cast / attack surface based on a transmutation buff); the 'spell ends if target drops to 0 HP' clause stays consumer-managed; 'can pass through narrow openings' is narrative.

conditions.engineNotes: Applied by Enthrall on a failed Wisdom save: a -10 penalty to Wisdom (Perception) checks until the spell ends (concentration-linked, so it clears when the caster's concentration drops). RAW deviations: the -10 to Passive Perception is not modeled (no derive sums modifiers into passive Perception today; only the active-check penalty is wired), and the 'any creature you or your companions are fighting automatically succeeds on the save' clause is consumer-managed (the engine doesn't model combat relationships, so the caster omits such creatures from the cast's targets).

Not currently used by any spell mechanic; Potion of Resistance (Force) is the canonical user.

conditions.name: Healing Blocked
conditions.description: Bearer cannot regain hit points.
conditions.engineNotes: Bearer cannot regain hit points. Heal planners consult this via the effect stack and, when set, emit Healed with amount=0 (the reducer's amount<=0 early-return makes it a no-op) plus an annotation in the Healed event's `source` field. Applied by Spirit Shroud's three variants via an ApplyCondition TriggerAction on each weapon-hit rider with `durationRounds: 1`; the dispatcher stamps `expiresOnRound = currentRound + 1` on the ConditionApplied event (when inside an active encounter), and `planAdvanceTurn` emits a `ConditionRemoved` at the start of the source caster's next turn. Outside an encounter the expiry stays consumer-managed.

conditions.name: Chill Touch (No Healing)
conditions.engineNotes: Slice 796: Chill Touch on-hit rider (SRD 5.2.1: 'it can't regain Hit Points until the end of your next turn'). BlockHealing + autoExpiry { afterRounds 1, turnEnd } — the same end-of-caster's-next-turn window guiding-bolt-glow / color-sprayed-blinded-active use (the encounter sweep keys on sourceCharacterId). Distinct from healing-blocked-active (the no-autoExpiry Spirit Shroud variant) precisely because this one carries its own self-lifting window. Applied via the attack mechanic's conditionOnHit; the slice-796 on-hit path stamps the autoExpiry.

conditions.name: Fire Shield: Warm
conditions.description: Caster has Resistance to Cold damage, and any creature that hits caster with a melee attack takes 2d8 fire damage.
conditions.engineNotes: Caster has Resistance to Cold damage, and any creature that hits caster with a melee attack takes 2d8 fire damage. RAW also gates the retaliation on 'within 5 ft of you'; the engine doesn't model the 5-ft gate consistently so the rider fires on every melee hit to the bearer (slightly broader than RAW). Slice 123 added the `event.attackKind` melee gate. Picked at cast time when the caster chooses the 'warm' variant of Fire Shield.

conditions.name: Fire Shield: Chill
conditions.description: Caster has Resistance to Fire damage, and any creature that hits caster with a melee attack takes 2d8 cold damage. Same.
conditions.engineNotes: Caster has Resistance to Fire damage, and any creature that hits caster with a melee attack takes 2d8 cold damage. Same RAW caveats as the warm variant (5-ft gate unmodeled). Slice 123 added the `event.attackKind` melee gate. Picked at cast time when the caster chooses the 'chill' variant of Fire Shield.

conditions.name: Mirror Image
conditions.description: Three illusory duplicates protect the bearer (PHB 2024). On each incoming weapon attack, the planner rolls a deflection d20: 6+ at 3 duplicates, 8+ at 2, 11+ at 1 redirects the attack to a duplicate with AC 10 + bearer DEX mod. A hit destroys the duplicate; a miss does nothing. When all 3 duplicates are destroyed, the condition is removed automatically. The bearer's AppliedCondition.level tracks remaining duplicates (starts at 3).
conditions.engineNotes: Three illusory duplicates protect the bearer (PHB 2024). On each incoming weapon attack, the planner rolls a deflection d20: 6+ at 3 duplicates, 8+ at 2, 11+ at 1 redirects the attack to a duplicate with AC 10 + bearer DEX mod. A hit destroys the duplicate; a miss does nothing. When all 3 duplicates are destroyed, the condition is removed automatically. The bearer's AppliedCondition.level tracks remaining duplicates (starts at 3). Slice 124 wires planAttack + planOffHandAttack; cast-spell.ts attack-mechanic spells (Eldritch Blast etc.) don't yet consult Mirror Image (deferred, rare in practice since most attacks against the bearer are weapon attacks). Slice 127 wires the RAW vision-gate: attackers with blindsight or truesight, or attackers carrying the Blinded condition, bypass the deflection entirely. Duration 1 minute, not concentration; consumer manages duration narratively.

conditions.name: Freedom of Movement Active
conditions.description: Movement is unrestrained: immune to grappled, restrained, paralyzed. The.
conditions.engineNotes: Movement is unrestrained: immune to grappled, restrained, paralyzed. The RAW also negates difficult-terrain and movement-reducing magic; those nuances aren't enforced by the engine yet.

conditions.name: Foresight Active
conditions.description: 8-hour buff (Foresight spell): advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws; attackers have disadvantage. The.
conditions.engineNotes: 8-hour buff (Foresight spell): advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws; attackers have disadvantage. The RAW 'can't be surprised' clause is consumer-side narrative metadata (surprise is initiative-order state, not a modeled condition).

conditions.name: Mind Blanked
conditions.description: 24-hour buff (Mind Blank spell): immune to Charmed and to psychic damage. The spell's additional.
conditions.engineNotes: 24-hour buff (Mind Blank spell): immune to Charmed and to psychic damage. The spell's additional RAW immunities (reading thoughts, magical scrying, emotion-detection) are narrative metadata; the engine doesn't model thought-reading or scrying detection.

conditions.name: Resisted
conditions.description: Resistance cantrip (SRD 5.2.1): the bearer chose one damage type at cast time; when it takes damage of that type, it reduces the total by 1d4, once per turn, for the spell's duration.
conditions.engineNotes: Resistance cantrip (SRD 5.2.1): the bearer chose one damage type at cast time; when it takes damage of that type, it reduces the total by 1d4, once per turn, for the spell's duration. The consumer calls engine.plan.consumeResistance({ targetId, damageType, damageAmount }) when the bearer takes damage of the chosen type; the planner rolls the 1d4 and emits a compensating Healed for the reduction (mirroring Absorb Elements, since the triggering DamageApplied has already committed). The marker carries empty effects because the reduction is the consumer-invoked reaction, not a passive modifier. Consumer-coordinated edges (documented): the once-per-turn cap and that the supplied damageType matches the cast-chosen type (the generic marker does not pin the type, exactly as Absorb Elements trusts its consumer-supplied type). Earlier this condition was a 2014-flavored 'add 1d4 to a save' stub with no consumer; slice 369 wired the 2024 damage-reduction behavior.

conditions.name: Stonecunning
conditions.description: Tremorsense 60 ft for 10 minutes (Dwarf Stonecunning trait). creature manages wall-clock expiry; 10 minutes per Bonus Action use.
conditions.engineNotes: Tremorsense 60 ft for 10 minutes (Dwarf Stonecunning trait). Consumer manages wall-clock expiry; RAW: 10 minutes per Bonus Action use. Per-Long-Rest PB-uses tracked via the dwarf's `stonecunning` resource.

conditions.name: Viciously Mocked
conditions.engineNotes: Slice 563: Vicious Mockery on-fail rider. RAW: 'Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.' One-shot: consumed when the bearer makes any attack (via consumeOnAttack); also auto-expires at end of bearer's next turn so the condition doesn't linger if the bearer never attacks. The Vicious Mockery save mechanic sets `applyConditionSourceFromTarget: true` so the autoExpiry's `turnEnd` sweep fires on the BEARER's next turn-end, not the caster's.

conditions.name: Frost's Chill (Slowed)
conditions.engineNotes: Slice 556: Goliath Giant Ancestry → Frost's Chill on-hit rider. -10 ft walk speed until the start of the attacker's next turn. autoExpiry: 1 round / turnStart fires at the start of the source's next turn, which RAW pins as the attacker's next turn (sourceCharacterId is the attacking Goliath).

conditions.name: Ray of Frost (Slowed)
conditions.engineNotes: Slice 796: Ray of Frost on-hit rider (SRD 5.2.1: 'its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn'). -10 ft walk speed; autoExpiry 1 round / turnStart fires at the start of the source caster's next turn (sourceCharacterId is the caster). Same mechanic as frosts-chill-slowed (the Goliath rider), kept as a dedicated spell-named variant per the per-source convention. Applied via the attack mechanic's conditionOnHit; the slice-796 on-hit path stamps the autoExpiry.

conditions.name: Raging
conditions.description: A Barbarian's Rage is active. Grants resistance to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing, +2 damage on STR-based attacks (.
conditions.engineNotes: A Barbarian's Rage is active. Grants resistance to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing, +2 damage on STR-based attacks (RAW Barbarian L1-3; +3 at L4-8, +4 at L9-15, +4 at L16+ — consumer reapplies with the appropriate variant at higher tiers), advantage on STR ability checks + saves. Slice 548: per RAW the Rage lasts until the end of the Barbarian's next turn (extendable by attacking, forcing a save, or BA) up to 10 minutes; the engine doesn't model the auto-extend logic today, so duration is consumer-managed via ConditionRemoved. Also deferred: 'No Concentration / no spells while raging' (would need a concentration-block primitive on the condition); auto-end on donning Heavy armor or becoming Incapacitated.

conditions.name: Mindless Rage
conditions.description: Path of the Berserker L6 Mindless Rage: while raging, the Barbarian is immune to the Charmed and Frightened conditions (SRD 5.2.1).
conditions.engineNotes: Path of the Berserker L6 Mindless Rage: while raging, the Barbarian is immune to the Charmed and Frightened conditions (SRD 5.2.1). Applied by planRage alongside `raging` when the barbarian has the Berserker subclass at level 6+; consumer-managed lifecycle (same `endsOn: longRest` as `raging`).

conditions.name: Longstrider
conditions.description: +10 ft walking Speed for 1 hour (Longstrider spell). The slice-77 ModifySpeed retrofit ensures the buff flows through the movement planner's getEffectiveSpeed.

conditions.name: Darkvision
conditions.description: Darkvision out to 60 ft for 8 hours (Darkvision spell).
conditions.engineNotes: Darkvision out to 60 ft for 8 hours (Darkvision spell). The engine stores the sense grant on the target's effect stack; consumers expose it via the character view's senses surface.

conditions.name: Studied Target
conditions.description: Fighter has Advantage on the next attack roll against the studied creature (Studied Attacks, Fighter L13). The condition lives on the fighter with `sourceCharacterId` set to the missed creature (slice 108's `sourceFromEventTarget` flag on ApplyConditionToAttacker); SetAdvantageVsSource keys against that creature so only attacks against THAT target get the bonus. The OnEvent rider consumes the condition on the fighter's next attack against the studied creature (`event.attackerIsSelf` + `event.targetIsSource`, consumeOnTrigger), regardless of hit/miss. Known limitations: (1)
conditions.engineNotes: Fighter has Advantage on the next attack roll against the studied creature (Studied Attacks, Fighter L13). The condition lives on the fighter with `sourceCharacterId` set to the missed creature (slice 108's `sourceFromEventTarget` flag on ApplyConditionToAttacker); SetAdvantageVsSource keys against that creature so only attacks against THAT target get the bonus. The OnEvent rider consumes the condition on the fighter's next attack against the studied creature (`event.attackerIsSelf` + `event.targetIsSource`, consumeOnTrigger), regardless of hit/miss. Known limitations: (1) RAW also expires the studying "before end of your next turn" — that time-window expiry isn't modeled (the consumer can remove the condition manually at end of turn). (2) Consecutive misses against the same target don't refresh: the second miss's class-feature OnEvent re-applies, but the ConditionApplied reducer dedupes by conditionId so the second application is a no-op while the consume rider still fires, leaving the condition gone. Most playgroups won't hit this edge case.

conditions.name: Death Ward
conditions.description: Up to 8 hours (Death Ward spell): the first time the warded creature would drop to 0 HP from damage, the damage is reduced so HP lands at 1 and this condition is removed. Every primary-damage emitter (planAttack, planCastSpell, planFalling, planOffhandAttack, planWeaponMastery Graze, planTrap, concentration-aura damage, recurring damage) consults the slice-111 `interceptFatalDamage` helper after `mitigateDamage` and emits a paired ConditionRemoved when the intercept fires. Known limitation: rider-emitted DamageApplied events from the trigger dispatcher (Sneak Attack, smite damage, Spirit Shroud rider, Fire Shield retaliation) do NOT consult the intercept — they fire before the main damage event in commit order, and if a rider alone is enough to drop the target, Death Ward stays applied and the target drops normally. A future slice can refactor the dispatcher to apply each fired trigger's events to a running draft before evaluating the next.

conditions.name: True Seeing
conditions.description: 1 hour (True Seeing spell). the willing creature you touch has Truesight with a range of 120 feet.
conditions.engineNotes: 1 hour (True Seeing spell). RAW (SRD 5.2.1): 'the willing creature you touch has Truesight with a range of 120 feet.' Slice 301 wired via the existing slice-127 GrantSense primitive. Truesight composes with slice-271's attacker.bypassesSightIllusion and slice-273's canLocateInvisible facts, so a True-Sighted creature automatically pierces Blur, Mirror Image, and the Invisible condition's visibility-bypass for both attack and target sides. The 1-hour duration is consumer-managed.

conditions.name: Warding Bond
conditions.description: 1 hour (Warding Bond spell). While the target is within 60 feet of you, it gains a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws, and it has Resistance to all damage. Also, each time it takes damage, you take the same amount of damage.
conditions.engineNotes: 1 hour (Warding Bond spell). RAW (SRD 5.2.1): 'While the target is within 60 feet of you, it gains a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws, and it has Resistance to all damage. Also, each time it takes damage, you take the same amount of damage.' Slice 301 wired three of the four arms: +1 AC, +1 save-wildcard (slice-299 primitive), Resistance to all damage. The 60-ft proximity gate is consumer-managed (engine doesn't model positions). The damage-sharing arm (caster takes equal damage on each hit to the target) is deferred — needs a new shared-damage-link primitive that emits a paired DamageApplied to the linked source character on every DamageApplied to the bearer (composes with slice-95's mitigateDamage but the source-link is novel). Sibling deferral with Spirit Guardians / Warding Wind shape if those ever land.

conditions.name: Heroes' Feast
conditions.description: 24 hours (Heroes' Feast spell, L6). partaking creature has Resistance to Poison, Immunity to Frightened + Poisoned conditions, and Hit Point maximum increases by 2d10 (with HP gain to match).
conditions.engineNotes: 24 hours (Heroes' Feast spell, L6). RAW (SRD 5.2.1): partaking creature has Resistance to Poison, Immunity to Frightened + Poisoned conditions, and Hit Point maximum increases by 2d10 (with HP gain to match). Slice 302 wired the 3 always-on arms via existing primitives (GrantResistance + 2x GrantConditionImmunity). The 2d10 HP max bonus arm is deferred — needs a per-cast random rolled value baked at cast time and threaded into HPMaxBonusChanged, distinct from the existing Aid wire which uses a fixed flat bonus. The 1-hour 'feast must finish before effects set in' delay is consumer-managed.

conditions.name: Wind Walking
conditions.description: 8 hours (Wind Walk spell, L6). each target becomes a wisp of cloud with Fly Speed 300 (and can hover), Immunity to Prone, and Resistance to Bludgeoning / Piercing / Slashing damage. The cloud form restricts available actions to Dash or a Magic action to revert; reverting takes 1 minute during which the target is Stunned.
conditions.engineNotes: 8 hours (Wind Walk spell, L6). RAW (SRD 5.2.1): each target becomes a wisp of cloud with Fly Speed 300 (and can hover), Immunity to Prone, and Resistance to Bludgeoning / Piercing / Slashing damage. The cloud form restricts available actions to Dash or a Magic action to revert; reverting takes 1 minute during which the target is Stunned. Slice 302 wired the 5 always-on arms via existing primitives (ModifySpeed fly 300 + GrantConditionImmunity prone + 3x GrantResistance B/P/S). The action restriction (only Dash or Magic-to-revert) is consumer-managed (mirror of slice-287 gaseous-form-active: the engine doesn't auto-restrict the cast/attack surface based on a transmutation buff). The reverting-takes-1-minute Stunned-during state is also consumer-managed (the consumer applies the Stunned condition during revert).

conditions.name: Stoneskin
conditions.description: Concentration, up to 1 hour (Stoneskin spell, SRD form): resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Wired via the slice-112 `qualifier: 'nonmagical'` field on GrantResistance: every emitter that consults `mitigateDamage` passes a `sourceIsMagical` flag, and the resistance check honors the qualifier. Weapon attacks with `temporaryBuff` set (Magic Weapon / Elemental Weapon) count as magical and bypass the resistance; spell-sourced damage is always magical. Note: the 2024 PHB Stoneskin dropped the qualifier; this entry follows the SRD 5.2 shape to exercise the primitive. The same `qualifier` field unblocks the common MM trait 'resistance to B/P/S damage from nonmagical attacks' on future monster authoring. Known limitation: rider-emitted damage from the trigger dispatcher (Sneak Attack, smites, Spirit Shroud, Fire Shield) bypasses `mitigateDamage` entirely and therefore also bypasses the qualifier — pre-existing dispatcher quirk separate from this slice.

conditions.name: Sanctuary
conditions.description: Up to 1 minute (Sanctuary spell): any creature that targets the warded creature with an attack roll or a harmful spell must first make a WIS save against the caster's spell DC. the creature rolls the attacker's save via `engine.plan.sanctuaryWardSave({ attackerId, wardedCharacterId })` before invoking the attack planner; on a failed save the planner emits a `SanctuaryProtected` event and the creature drops the attack. The spell ends when the bearer makes an attack roll (modeled here via an OnEvent rider with consumeOnTrigger).
conditions.engineNotes: Up to 1 minute (Sanctuary spell): any creature that targets the warded creature with an attack roll or a harmful spell must first make a WIS save against the caster's spell DC. The consumer rolls the attacker's save via `engine.plan.sanctuaryWardSave({ attackerId, wardedCharacterId })` before invoking the attack planner; on a failed save the planner emits a `SanctuaryProtected` event and the consumer drops the attack. The spell ends when the bearer makes an attack roll (modeled here via an OnEvent rider with consumeOnTrigger). RAW also ends the spell when the bearer casts a harmful spell or deals damage to another creature; those vectors aren't modeled today (the dispatcher has no `castDeclared-with-hostile-target` or `dealtDamage` fact).

conditions.name: Protection from Evil and Good
conditions.description: Aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead have disadvantage on attack rolls against the bearer (Protection from Evil and Good spell). The disadvantage gate is enforced via a type-conditional ImposeDisadvantageOnAttackers whose predicate reads `attackerCreatureType` from facts the attack planner supplies. The bearer is also immune to charmed and frightened *from those same six types*; slice 104 added a source-predicate to GrantConditionImmunity so isImmuneToCondition (called from the cast-spell save and buff branches and from the concentration aura tick) gates the immunity on the casting source's creatureType matching the six warded types. The.
conditions.engineNotes: Aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead have disadvantage on attack rolls against the bearer (Protection from Evil and Good spell). The disadvantage gate is enforced via a type-conditional ImposeDisadvantageOnAttackers whose predicate reads `attackerCreatureType` from facts the attack planner supplies. The bearer is also immune to charmed and frightened *from those same six types*; slice 104 added a source-predicate to GrantConditionImmunity so isImmuneToCondition (called from the cast-spell save and buff branches and from the concentration aura tick) gates the immunity on the casting source's creatureType matching the six warded types. The RAW 'possessed' clause isn't modeled (the engine doesn't carry a possessed condition). The shared range / duration distinction with Magic Circle lives on the spell entry, not the condition.

conditions.name: Magic Circle
conditions.description: 10-foot cylinder ward (Magic Circle spell): creatures of the warded type have disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures inside the circle, and can't charm or frighten them. Shares the disadvantage + condition-immunity shape with Protection from Evil and Good (same six creature types — aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, undead).
conditions.engineNotes: 10-foot cylinder ward (Magic Circle spell): creatures of the warded type have disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures inside the circle, and can't charm or frighten them. Shares the disadvantage + condition-immunity shape with Protection from Evil and Good (same six creature types — aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, undead). RAW lets the caster name a single creature type at cast time; the engine doesn't model the caster choice yet, so the condition wards against all six (broader than RAW for non-fiend casts). The RAW positional constraint (only applies while the warded creature is inside the 10-foot cylinder) is consumer-territory.

conditions.name: Holy Aura
conditions.description: Concentration up to 1 minute (Holy Aura spell): bearer has advantage on saving throws (universal), all attack rolls against the bearer have disadvantage (universal), and any Fiend or Undead that hits the bearer with a melee attack is blinded via an OnEvent rider gated on the attacker's creature type.
conditions.engineNotes: Concentration up to 1 minute (Holy Aura spell): bearer has advantage on saving throws (universal), all attack rolls against the bearer have disadvantage (universal), and any Fiend or Undead that hits the bearer with a melee attack is blinded via an OnEvent rider gated on the attacker's creature type. RAW gates the blind on a failed CON save and on the attack being melee; neither gate is enforced today (the dispatcher doesn't have an attackKind fact, and ApplyCondition TriggerActions don't roll a save). The auto-expiry of the blinded condition rides slice 102's `durationRounds`-to-`expiresOnRound` plumbing.

conditions.name: Aura of Protection Active
conditions.description: CHA-modifier bonus to all saves (min +1) granted by a nearby Paladin's L6+ Aura of Protection. The bonus reads the source Paladin's CHA score via the AppliedCondition sourceCharacterId link.
